name: Rennes
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the greater Rennes metropolitan area (France), from Rennes-Saint-Jacques airport to Cesson-Sevigne and Saint-Gregoire. 122k+ OSM buildings (binary format), 297k+ commuters with demand built from real INSEE census data. Rennes-Saint-Jacques airport with runways and taxiways. Protomaps basemap with water, parks and forests.
data_source: INSEE Filosofi 2021 (donnees carroyees, revenus et population) - INSEE Recensement de la population 2021, mobilites professionnelles - OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL) - Overture Maps Foundation (buildings)
